items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: there was a band that put together with clarinetist Tom Sharpstein and Conrad Janis was the trombone player

ctx.x: in California who did you play with did we cover that when you

started well it was just an amateur band there was a band that put together with clarinetist Tom Sharpstein and Conrad Janis was the trombone player and some other people we cut a little disc in a basketball court one night at some high school in Glendale and mailed it into the record changer magazine they were having their first annual amateur jazz band contest our band won I think we sent in a crude recording of Canal Street Blues and maybe Snake Rag something like that very King Oliver oriented at that time…
